metadata.description: Governed Cursor plugins for PR security, MCP gateway controls, production triage, database change safety, GitOps releases, and compliance evidence.

plugins.name: secure-pr-guardian
plugins.description: Read-first PR security automations: secrets, vulns, API review, threat-model delta, CI hardening, risk summary.

plugins.name: mcp-security-gateway
plugins.description: Control plane for MCP allowlists, redaction, approval proxy, budgets, and injection firewall.

plugins.name: production-triage-copilot
plugins.description: Read-only incident and CI triage with timelines, clusters, traces, SLO burn, and Kubernetes diagnostics.

plugins.name: database-change-guardian
plugins.description: Migration and tenant-isolation safety reviews with plan-only GitOps outputs.

plugins.name: gitops-release-controller
plugins.description: Release checklist, canary analysis, rollback PR generation, provenance and drift detection.

plugins.name: compliance-evidence-engine
plugins.description: SOC 2, HIPAA, NIST mapping and audit evidence packs from operational artifacts.
